description_en: Queries the user credential reports of an Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询阿里云账号（主账号）下的用户凭证报告
name: GetCredentialReport

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to initiate the next request if the response of the current request is truncated. You can use the token to initiate another request and obtain the remaining records.\`\`
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，可以使用`NextToken`获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. If a response is truncated because it reaches the value of `MaxItems`, the value of `IsTruncated` will be true.

Valid values: 1 to 3501. Default value: 3501
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果的条数。当返回结果达到`MaxItems`限制被截断时，返回参数`IsTruncated`将等于true。

取值范围：1~3501。默认值：3501
parameters.name: max_items
